Subject S.P. Balanovsky.
Made by D.S. Pavloff Forwarded by D. L. Crawford

Sergey Petrovitch BALANOVSKY, alias
Belanovsky, alias Belanorsky, alias Boolanovsky,
alias "Serejka Poliak", Russian, was born on
September 8, 1895 in Harkov, Russia. In 1920,
he was employed at Vladivostok in the Intelligence
Service of the White Russian Government,
"Police Inspection Department of the Ministry
of Home Affairs" (Information Section). It is
reported that during this time he was arrested
on a charge of being a Bolshevik secret agent.
However he was released due to the intervention
of certain friends and Japanese officials for
whom it was suspected he acted as informer.

Balanovsky arrived in Shanghai from
Vladivostok on November 25, 1922. On June 27,
1923 he took out a passport through the Russian
Emigrants' Committee with the intention of
visiting the U.S.A. In 1925 he was found to be
residing at a boarding house at No. 9 Dent
Road under the nickname of "Serejka Poliak".
At that time he cohabited with one V. Borodovsky,
Russian Jewess, who was the proprietress of
the house. This woman has a doubtful reputation
and is reported to be the widow of a well known
card-sharper. Her boarding house was frequented
by certain known smugglers.

On July 26, 1925 Balanovsky was arrested

谢尔盖·彼得罗维奇·巴拉诺夫斯基（Sergey Petrovitch BALANOVSKY），别名
贝拉诺夫斯基（Belanovsky），别名贝拉诺尔斯基（Belanorsky），别名布兰诺夫斯基（Boolanovsky），
别名“谢列伊卡·波利亚克”（"Serejka Poliak"），俄罗斯人，生于
1895年9月8日，出生地为俄罗斯哈尔科夫（Harkov）。1920年，
他在海参崴受雇于白俄政府的情报部门，
即“内政部警察视察局”（情报科）。据报
在此期间，他因涉嫌作为布尔什维克秘密特工
而被捕。然而，由于某些朋友以及日本官员的干预，
他得以获释，有人怀疑他曾为这些日本官员充当线人。

巴拉诺夫斯基于1922年11月25日
从海参崴抵达上海。1923年6月27日，他通过
俄罗斯移民委员会申领护照，意图
前往美国。1925年，发现他
以“谢列伊卡·波利亚克”的绰号居住在登特路（Dent Road）9号的一家寄宿公寓内。
当时，他与一名俄罗斯犹太女子 V. Borodovsky 同居，
该女子是这栋房子的业主。这名女子名声不佳，
据报是一名知名职业骗牌手的遗孀。她的寄宿公寓
常有一些已知的走私者光顾。

1925年7月26日，巴拉诺夫斯基被捕

Subject (in full) Further report re: S.P.Balanovsky.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]
Further enquiries regarding S.P.Balanovsky's alleged connection with gambling conducted in Apartment 3, No. 203 Seymour Road confirm the information contained in reports submitted by D.S.Tcheremshansky dated September 23 and October 4, 1933, respectively. ( File D-5272 ).
Information from three reliable and entirely independent sources indicates that Balanovsky participates in gambling activities at the above address. Moreover, there are good reasons to believe that his connection with the place is not merely that of an occasional visitor, but that he is an employee, if not a member, of the syndicate which conducts gambling for the purpose of gain. It is reported that apart from Dike Neilmayer mentioned in D.S.Tcheremshansky's reports a certain V.I.Lahutin, Russian, who has the reputation of being a professional gambler, is also a member of the gambling syndicate in question.
There seems to be no doubt that Balanovsky was in a similar way connected with the gambling house which was kept by one J.B.Cheney at No 7 Route de Grouchy in 1930-1931.
Photograph of S.P.Balanovsky is attached herewith.
a. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

owned by one J.B. Cheney, American (File D-2694) at No.7
Route Grouchy.
For some time in 1932-3 Balanovsky was working as a
contractor on a small scale (repair work, painting etc.)
During the period July-September 1933 he was employed as
cashier at a certain secret gambling den conducted by one Liado,
Spanish and one Dike Neilmayer, Netherlands subject, in
Apartment 3, No.203 Seymour Road. At the present time
Balanovsky claim to be employed in selling radio sets on a
commission basis.
On November 10, 1928 Balanovsky joined the Russian Company
S.V.C., and during March 1933 he was promoted to the rank of
Second Lieutenant.
He resides at No.516 Rue Bourgeat.
G. Tchernischansky
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

Dec. 2, 1940.

Proposed establishment of a gambling den at Passage 100,
House 10, Route de Say Zoong.

On November 25, 1940, information was
received from a representative of the Shanghai Land
Investment Co., 100 Jinkee Road, to the effect that
Lieut. S.F. Balanowsky, Russian Regiment, S.V.C.,
had on several occasions since November 14, 1940
visited the aforesaid Company's office and attempted
to negotiate a lease of House 10, Passage 100,
Route de Say Zoong, on behalf of a Japanese, namely
Mr. K. Onishi, Manager of Restaurant Tayo Shokudo,
"Tiger House" 475-479 North Szechuen Road. Owing
to the fact that the house in question is a
commodious building, comprising 30 lavishly furnished
rooms, the Shanghai Land Investment Co., suspecting
that Onishi intended to convert it into a gaming
house, instituted confidential enquiries through a
Japanese source which indicated that Onishi is
connected with local gambling interest and that
gambling takes place at Tiger House more or less
regularly. In consequence of this information,
Balanowsky was informed that another party had an
option on the lease and that there was no possibility
of his being able to rent the building. Despite
this, Balanowsky persistently visited the Company's
office and importuned the management to rent the
house mentioned, to Onishi, even going to the length
of bringing a copy of a certificate of identity from
the Japanese Consulate in respect of Onishi and
a written undertaking not to carry out any

拟在赛宗路（Route de Say Zoong）100弄10号设立赌窟。

1940年11月25日，收到金基路100号上海地产公司（Shanghai Land Investment Co.）代表的消息，称自1940年11月14日以来，上海义勇队（S.V.C.）俄籍军团巴拉诺夫斯基（Balanowsky）中尉多次访问上述公司办公室，试图代表一名日本人——即四川北路475-479号“虎屋”（Tiger House）大阳食堂（Tayo Shokudo）经理大西（K. Onishi，音译）先生——协商租赁赛宗路100弄10号的事宜。鉴于该房屋是一栋宽敞的建筑，包含30间装修豪华的房间，上海地产公司怀疑大西意图将其改为赌场，遂通过一名日本线人进行秘密调查，结果显示大西与当地赌博势力有关联，且“虎屋”或多或少定期有赌博活动。基于此情报，已告知巴拉诺夫斯基另有方拥有该租赁权的选择权，他不可能租下该建筑。尽管如此，巴拉诺夫斯基仍持续前往该公司办公室，纠缠管理层要求将上述房屋租给大西，甚至带来了日本领事馆出具的大西身份证明书副本，以及一份书面承诺，保证不对建筑物进行任何

Balanowsky, according to information
in possession of the Police, has for many years
been connected with the various foreign and Chinese
gambling interests in Shanghai; also, he is known
to be an agent of one of the local Japanese secret
organs. There can be little doubt, therefore,
that Balanowsky was acting as an agent of the
gambling interests. Information from another
source, usually reliable, is to the effect that
House 10, Passage 100, Route de Say Zoong, which
is the former residence of General Hsiung Shih Hwei
(熊式輝), Chairman of Kiangsi Provincial Govern-
ment, was rented by Li Siao Pao (李筱宝),
conductor of Si Yuen Gambling Den, Chung Hwa Road,
Old West Gate, and Sih Hung Kee (薛鴻記) Building
Contractor, Lane 116, 5 Wuting Road, for the
purpose of establishing a gambling house. The plan
has, however, been shelved for the time being, owing
to the East Asia Dramatic Research Society, a
gambling den situated on Rue Amiral Courbet, having
been suppressed by the French Police. In this
connection it is said that the French Authorities
have determined to suppress gambling in the French
Concession under any circumstances.

据警方掌握的情报，巴拉诺夫斯基多年来一直与上海各外国及中国赌博势力有联系；此外，众所周知，他是当地某日本秘密机关的代理人。因此，毫无疑问，巴拉诺夫斯基是作为赌博势力的代理人在行事。来自另一通常可靠来源的情报显示，赛宗路100弄10号（原江西省政府主席熊式辉将军的故居）已被李筱宝（Li Siao Pao，老西门中华路四园赌窟主持人）和薛鸿记（Sih Hung Kee，音译，武定路5号116弄建筑承包商）租用，目的是开设赌场。然而，由于位于亚尔培辣路（Rue Amiral Courbet）的东亚戏剧研究社（East Asia Dramatic Research Society，实为赌窟）被法国警察取缔，该计划暂时搁置。就此而言，据说法国当局已决心在任何情况下都要取缔法租界内的赌博活动。
